entries.name: Drake Maye
entries.summary: For now, Maye -- who suffered a fractured right fibula during a Week 10 loss to the Lions -- remains on the Patriots' 53-man roster rather than injured reserve, with coach Mike Vrabel citing the "balance" the team is hoping to strike with regard to managing its remaining designated to return from IR slots, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: J.K. Dobbins
entries.summary: Broncos head coach Sean Payton announced Tuesday that Dobbins has been suspended one game for conduct detrimental to the team, Chris Tomasson of The Denver Gazette reports.

entries.name: Jake Ferguson
entries.summary: The Cowboys ruled Ferguson (knee/ankle) out for Thursday's game against the Eagles, Patrik Walker of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Jonathan Mingo
entries.summary: Mingo (ankle) did not participate in practice Tuesday.

entries.name: Kenneth Walker III
entries.summary: The Chiefs ruled out Walker (groin) for Thursday's game against the Bills.

entries.name: Luke Musgrave
entries.summary: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Saturday that he doesn't anticipate Musgrove (neck) returning from the PUP list this season, according to NFL reporter Jason B. Hirschhorn.

entries.name: Roschon Johnson
entries.summary: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out  for Thursday's game against the Lions.

entries.name: Seth McGowan
entries.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said that McGowan will miss some time after injuring his hamstring in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans, Stephen Holder of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown (hamstring) didn't take part in practice Wednesday, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

entries.name: Jordan Addison
entries.summary: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Addison will be listed as a non-participant on Wednesday's injury report, Ben Goessling of the Minnesota Star Tribune reports.

entries.name: Ben Skowronek
entries.summary: Skowronek (calf) did not practice Tuesday.

entries.name: Bhayshul Tuten
entries.summary: Tuten (ankle) wasn't spotted at Wednesday's practice,  Demetrius Harvey of the Florida Times Union reports.

entries.name: Bo Melton
entries.summary: Melton (thigh) is listed as questionable for Wednesday night's game against the Rams, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Brevin Jordan
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Brock Bowers
entries.summary: Bowers (ankle/quadriceps) was on the field for Wednesday's practice, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Brock Purdy
entries.summary: Purdy didn't practice Wednesday due to an ankle injury, Vic Tafur of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Carson Beck
entries.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Beck (back) won't practice Wednesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Dalton Kincaid
entries.summary: Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is listed as questionable for Thursday night's contest against the Chiefs.

entries.name: Dareke Young
entries.summary: Young (stinger) is questionable to return to Sunday's contest against Denver.

entries.name: Denzel Boston
entries.summary: Boston (toe) wasn't spotted at Wednesday's practice, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Derrick Henry
entries.summary: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said that Henry was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice after being placed back in concussion protocol, but the running back is expected to be available for Sunday's game against the Texans, Cordell Woodland of 105.7 The Fan Baltimore reports.

entries.name: Drew Ogletree
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Isaiah Likely
entries.summary: Likely (groin) was limited in practice Wednesday, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

entries.name: Isaiah Williams
entries.summary: Williams (ribs) was listed as a limited participant on Wednesday's estimated practice report.

entries.name: Jakobi Meyers
entries.summary: Meyers was spotted working off to the side during Wednesday's practice, Demetrius Harvey of The Florida Times-Union reports.

entries.name: Jared Wayne
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Josh Jacobs
entries.summary: The Packers list Jacobs (finger) as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Rams, Wes Hodkiewicz of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Justin Herbert
entries.summary: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh said that Herbert (concussion) won't practice Wednesday, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Juwan Johnson
entries.summary: Saints head coach Kellen Moore said Monday that Johnson is still undergoing further medical evaluation after injuring his hamstring during Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears, Ross Jackson of WWL-TV reports.

entries.name: Kayshon Boutte
entries.summary: Boutte's hip injury he suffered in Thursday night's win over the Colts doesn't appear to be serious, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Keaton Mitchell
entries.summary: Mitchell (back) has re-entered Sunday's game against the Jets, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Kyler Murray
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
entries.summary: Harrison (hamstring) was at practice Wednesday, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle  reports.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans (Achilles) won't practice Wednesday, Harrison Rich of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.

entries.name: Noah Gray
entries.summary: Gray (ribs) is listed as questionable for Thursday night's game against the Bills.

entries.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
entries.summary: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Cooper (ankle/hip) won't practice Wednesday and is considered day-to-day.

entries.name: Sam Darnold
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald reiterated that Darnold (quadriceps/rib) will start Sunday against the 49ers if the quarterback fares well during Wednesday's practice,  Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Skyy Moore
entries.summary: Moore (ankle) is listed as questionable for Wednesday night's game against the Rams, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: Stefon Diggs
entries.summary: Diggs was absent from Wednesday's practice and was excused, Ben Standig of The Team 980 reports.

entries.name: Tetairoa McMillan
entries.summary: Head coach Dave Canales said Wednesday that the Panthers are "optimistic" that McMillan (foot) will play Monday in Tampa Bay, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Will Mallory
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Woody Marks
entries.summary: Marks (concussion) was on the practice field Wednesday, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle  reports.

entries.name: Zachariah Branch
entries.summary: Branch (hamstring) went through warmups during the media-viewing portion of Monday's unofficial practice session, Daniel Flick of The Atlanta Journal-Constitution reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: When addressing the press Wednesday, Pierce (heel) noted that the offseason procedure he underwent this past March was done because he was dealing with heel pain that impacted his Achilles, Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.

entries.name: Andrei Iosivas
entries.summary: Iosivas (thumb) was downgraded to out for Monday's game against the Commanders, Mike Petraglia of CLNSCincy.com reports.

entries.name: Davante Adams
entries.summary: Adams (hamstring) has an "outside chance" to return from injured reserve for the Rams' Week 13 matchup with the Chiefs but is more likely to be activated around mid-December, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
entries.summary: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said Wednesday that Stribling (ankle) is likely at least "a couple weeks away" from returning to practice, Harrison Rich of the San Francisco Chronicle reports. "I don't know. I mean, nothing's changed," Shanahan said, regarding a timeline for the rookie receiver.

entries.name: Dontayvion Wicks
entries.summary: The Eagles placed Wicks (ankle/foot) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: George Holani
entries.summary: The Seahawks placed Holani (knee) on injured reserve Monday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Jalen McMillan
entries.summary: The Buccaneers designated McMillan (knee) for return from injured reserve Wednesday, Scott Smith of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Jared Wiley
entries.summary: The Chiefs placed Wiley (ankle) on injured reserve Wednesday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

entries.name: Jeremiyah Love
entries.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that the Cardinals will evaluate Love (ankle) again Monday to hone in on a return date for the running back, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

entries.name: Malik Willis
entries.summary: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that, at this time, surgery to address Willis' groin/core injury is not foreseen, Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: Pittman (foot) was listed as a full participant in Wednesday's practice,Alan Saunders of SteelersNow.com reports.

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: Nacua (knee/toe) is expected to be sidelined 4-to-5 months after undergoing surgery Tuesday to repair his right MCL, which means he won't be on track to return at any point during the playoffs, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Raheim Sanders
entries.summary: The Browns designated Sanders (hip) for return from injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Romeo Doubs
entries.summary: The Patriots designated Doubs (shoulder) for return from injured reserve Wednesday, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Monday that Ferguson (hamstring) won't be activated from injured reserve this season and will require surgery to address the ankle injury he aggravated in Week 3, Stu Jackson of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Tyler Badie
entries.summary: The Broncos designated Badie (thumb) for return from injured reserve Tuesday, Susanna Weir of the team's official site reports.
